# Beyond Border Group

> One group, three practices: AI consulting and production, cross-border marketing between China and the West, and AI-powered media and software products the group owns and operates.

Beyond Border Group Ltd, registered in Hong Kong, is the holding group for three practices that share one AI stack. Every team takes clients directly, and most clients start with one. Offices in Shanghai, Hong Kong, Singapore, Paris, and Hangzhou, with representatives in the US, UK, Germany, and France.

## Practices

- [AI Services](https://www.beyondbordergroup.org/ai-services/): AI consulting and production, evidence over hype. Western and Chinese models benchmarked side by side.
- [Cross-Border Marketing](https://www.beyondbordergroup.org/cross-border-marketing/): Four specialists carrying brands between China and the West, both ways.
- [Products](https://www.beyondbordergroup.org/products/): Media and software the group owns and operates, on the same stack it sells.

## AI Services brands

- [BearingBridge AI](https://www.bearingbridge.com): The AI business platform. Marketing, sales, business intelligence, project management and customer service delivered as software, with agents that already know the trade.
- [HubStudio](https://hubstudio.ai): Content production at scale.
- [Nuvora Studio](https://nuvora.studio): LinkedIn-only B2B.

## Cross-Border Marketing agencies

- [TheChinaPath](https://thechinapath.com): Full-service China entry.
- [BeyondBridge](https://beyondbridge.ai): Chinese brands, Western pipeline.
- [ChinaWebFoundry](https://chinawebfoundry.com): Websites built for China.
- [TheRedScroll](https://theredscroll.com): Chinese social media specialist.

## Products

- [BBChien](https://bbchien.fr): An independent French media on dogs, live today.
- [DeuceLadder](https://www.deuceladder.com): Tennis ladder league software, live. Challenge-based standings with enforced deadlines, play windows, and two-sided score confirmation.
- [Visit Moganshan](https://www.visitmoganshan.com): An English travel guide to Moganshan, Zhejiang, three hours from Shanghai. Landing page live, guide in build.
